Stock options vest over a three year service period, beginning at the date of grant, and the compensation cost is recognized ratably during the vesting period. The total fair value of options that vested during 2009 and 2008 was $2.0 million and $0.5 million, respectively. No stock options vested in 2007. At December 31, 2009, we had $0.5 million of unrecognized compensation cost related to stock options that will be recognized over a weighted average period of 0.9 years. The weighted average grant date fair value of options granted during 2009, 2008, and 2007 was $4.45, $8.84, and $8.61, respectively.
